author: Stahly
description:
In parts 1 and 2, we covered light, cameras, and dialling in the perfect settings. So now you might be wondering: how do you actually get the most out of your raw material? In this post, I'm sharing my professional, yet completely free editing workflow: perfect white backgrounds, proper white balance, avoiding overexposed highlights, and removing dust specks. And the best part? You won't need to spend a penny on the software.

The post Mastering miniature photography #3: Free photo editing like a pro appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Mastering miniature photography #3: Free photo editing like a pro
